The documents don't show Fisichella's first Grand Prix win. The eight race reports cover 2000 and 2006 and place him third, fifth and sixth, with no win. So this answer relies on my own recall, not the retrieved information.

I believe his first and only win came at the 2005 Brazilian Grand Prix, driving for Renault. If so, Renault won the 2005 constructors' championship.

ANSWER: Renault
